entities.summary: Igor Yuryevich Kharlamov, known professionally as Garik Kharlamov is a Russian film, television, and voice actor, comedian, television presenter, singer, and producer. He is best known as the long-time resident, co-host, and creative producer of the Comedy Club show on TNT channel.
